note: The operational register for the parser: enforced by test/failure-register.test.ts and reported by npm run register:report. docs/learning/ERROR_REGISTER.md holds the longer accounts and older entries. A passing regression test shows this shape no longer fails; it does not show the mistake can never recur.

entries.summary: An agency's contact, or a form label, published as the candidate's
entries.source: 21 real development CVs (private) and invented library cases
entries.cause: First match wins, with no idea whose details a line holds
entries.measured: Real name wrong 6 to 0, e-mail wrong 4 to 0, phone wrong 4 to 0, against the owner's answers on the same 21 documents

entries.summary: Visible text drawn as shapes under a transparent copy was thrown away, losing a real name
entries.source: One real development CV (private), F-037
entries.cause: Whether text can be seen was decided from the file's drawing instructions alone
entries.measured: Name recovered on the real document; 11 of 13 marked pieces on other real documents stayed out

entries.summary: 'Curriculum Vitae' published as a person

entries.measured: Library case passes

entries.summary: Any large heading published as a person when nothing competed

entries.measured: 18 of 20 headings wrong to 2 of 20; a list written afterwards and run once, 1 of 20. Reduced, not eliminated: N-010, N-013 open

entries.summary: What a section is was decided by a list of heading wordings, so any new wording lost its section; adding wordings was patching
entries.source: Owner's direction, 2026-11-03: no patching. longform-b1 showed the failures; a first fix added more wordings and was removed
entries.cause: Headings decided sections, and a word list can never hold them all
entries.measured: 60 invented text CVs under meaningless headings: roles 145/149, skills 421/421, qualifications 75/75, certifications 69/69, languages 117/117, the same as printed. Real development CVs: documents with far fewer roles than date ranges 7 to 2 of 21

entries.summary: Two words stitched from separate lines deep on page 2 published as a person
entries.source: RC-414799, in the one acceptance run (acceptance-1), invented form F-039
entries.cause: Evidence such as sitting above a title or being used in the body raised a line to a name with nothing saying it was a person, and with no rival nothing stopped it
entries.measured: Real development CVs with answers: name wrong stays 0, right 20 to 19, and the wrong name on the acceptance CV no longer published. A person's name that is deep in a document with nothing confirming it is left blank: that cost is real.

entries.summary: A form label read as a value: location 'Phone:'
entries.source: A real CV the owner handed over for a match, 2026-11-03
entries.cause: Pieces of a contact row were offered as places with no check that a piece was a value at all; real CVs have no checked answers for location, so nothing caught it
entries.measured: Location on the owner's CV now right. Real CVs have no checked answers for location, which is why this went unseen

entries.summary: Word tables lost their rows, and a running header was read as an employer

entries.measured: Long-form Word group: employer wrong 13 to 0, certifications 97 to 129 of 129

entries.summary: A line break in a Word cell glued label to value in job descriptions ('LocationJohannesburg')

entries.measured: Job description location now read

entries.measured: Invented pairs on checked records: same-role median 54 to 56. On one same-role pair, 50 to 68. Ranking of same-role above adjacent unchanged at 1.00 on Word

entries.summary: Leading people who use a technology, or claiming familiarity, counted as using it

entries.summary: Years of managing counted as years of software development

entries.summary: A vague job line replaced a specific one; 'will be considered' and 'not mandatory' read as mandatory
entries.source: A real CV and sample job the owner handed over, 2026-11-03, compared with a careful reader's judgement
entries.cause: Duplicates kept whichever came first, and every line under a mandatory heading counted
entries.measured: On the owner's sample pair: the specific requirement is judged, and the sentence is no longer scored

entries.summary: A duty wrapped across lines loses its opening, so 'Lead the Centre... including' / 'Guidewire, Duck Creek, and Azure.' reads as Azure in use
entries.source: The owner's sample CV
entries.cause: A wrapped line is treated as a duty of its own when it starts with a capital

entries.summary: A certificate the CV says has expired was shown as Completed
entries.source: longform-b1: all 32 certification status errors in one group
entries.cause: There was no way to say a certificate no longer stands, and a past year reads as completed. Owner decision 2026-11-04: an expired certificate is history; it does not satisfy a requirement for a current one
entries.measured: Visual pack, certificate status on Word 60/9/0 to 69/0/0, PDF 57/8/0 to 65/0/0. Expired, current and unknown are separate, and a printed date is judged against the assessment date. A stated date is still the candidate's claim

entries.summary: One scan's match score differs from its checked record by 43 points
entries.source: visual60-b1, matching evaluation on cand-f2
entries.cause: Image cleanup damaged text at the edges of dark panels: R78
entries.measured: Largest drift 43 to 22 on scans; 34 on photos remains

entries.summary: Turning a dark panel left halos across the letters at its edges, losing skills on scans and photos
entries.source: visual60-b1, tracing a 43-point score drift to its cause
entries.cause: Panels were turned in whole grid blocks and left mid-grey, and the next step smeared both
entries.measured: Scan, same-role median 54 to 60; largest drift from the checked record 43 to 22 points. One CV went from 2 skills to all 8; one photo got worse, kept open under R81

entries.summary: Skills one per line split in two; a label stuck to the title; a course or issuer taken as a heading; a table's status and year columns read away from their rows
entries.source: longform-b1 fresh group
entries.cause: Aliases counted as whole skills; a section's word in a line was enough to make it a heading; only heading text protected a table from being read as columns
entries.measured: Never-seen long-form group on Word: skills 330 of 344, certifications 129 of 129

entries.summary: Wrong e-mails and phones read from scans and photos, about half of them not sent for review
entries.source: visual60-b1 cand-f3: 19 of 300 documents with a wrong name, e-mail or phone, 10 flagged; longform-b1 lf-fresh-3 scans: e-mail 29 right, 6 wrong, 8 missing
entries.cause: Diagnosed by stage (test/candidate/contactStages.ts). Of 57 addresses not read as one word on 120 development pages: spaces inserted inside the address, or a dropped dot, with the characters right, were the largest group; the end of the address wrapped in a narrow cell; and real misreads of a letter, which a closer look at the row often read correctly. A wrong owner was not the cause of any. One page reading had nothing to check itself against
entries.measured: On the 43 people, scans: e-mail 29 right, 6 wrong, 8 missing to 32, 1, 10; phone 41, 1, 1 to 43, 0, 0. Visual pack, photos: e-mail 37, 10, 13 to 50 right, 3 wrong, 7 missing on the last full comparison; phones 57, 1, 2 to 60, 0, 0. Failed unread run lf-unseen-5 still shows 4 wrong e-mails and 2 wrong phones of 43 scans, and e-mail only 70% right, so this is contained and not solved: when every reading shares a slip, nothing here can see it

entries.summary: Skills on searchable PDFs well below Word: 273 of 344 against 330 of 344 on the same people
entries.source: longform-b1 lf-fresh-3
entries.cause: Not established
entries.measured: See R84, which holds the causes. On the 43 people PDF skills 273 to 321 of 344; unread group 329 of 344; Word on the 43 unchanged at 330

entries.summary: Two e-mail recovery tests failed once in a full local run: RECOVERY (invitation), and WELCOME, which uses the people that test creates
entries.source: Full local suite, 2026-11-03, on top of 96f1145
entries.cause: Not established, and the failing assertion was not kept: that run saved only the test names. Ruled out by evidence: the local auth service (no 429 and no 5xx on these paths in its log for the whole period), load alone (3 of 3 passed beside an OCR batch, and two full suites passed beside OCR runs). WELCOME depending on the earlier test means this was one failure, not two. Still possible: test file order, or a timing in the fault injection
entries.measured: Failure once, on 2026-11-03. Since then, on candidate-4 and candidate-5: 3 full suites in usual order and 1 shuffled passed these tests, and 3 of 3 alone beside an OCR run. Not reproduced, so not resolved. Every run now keeps its full failure text in data/test-runs, so a repeat can be understood

entries.summary: PDF lost skills that Word kept
entries.source: longform-b1 remainder 2 (development): skills 292 of 344 on PDF, 339 on Word; 50 of the 52 lost were in the text the reader produced
entries.cause: The text was read; it was lost after. Four shared causes: labels in a margin read as a column of their own, apart from what they label; words bold in one place treated as headings where they are plain list items; a list's first row taken as a heading; two columns of flowing text taken for a table's rows
entries.measured: Same group: PDF 292 to 331 of 344, Word 339 to 343

entries.summary: A line saying the person had not done something counted as doing it
entries.source: Counterexamples for rules 2.3.0: 'I have not used SAP', 'Would like to learn Python', 'Worked alongside the data team, who built models in Python' were all verified at 100
entries.cause: Described use looked only at whether the skill was named in a line of work with enough other words. Nothing read what the line said about it. Known since R1 and held as an expected failure
entries.measured: All three not demonstrated, with the line quoted for a person to read. R1 passes. The words are a list in the ruleset, so other wordings will get through: a known weak spot

entries.summary: A sentence from the column beside was published as the location
entries.source: visual60-b1 CV0530 on PDF and scan: Filing, Supplier coordination and Excel. Currently
entries.cause: A row holding the person's contact details also held a line of the other column, and every piece beside a contact counted as a possible place
entries.measured: Location now Pretoria on PDF and scan; visual pack PDF location 59/1/0 to 60/0/0

entries.summary: The fall in review was reported as an improvement without saying how much came from changed rules
entries.source: server/test/candidate/reviewAnalysis.ts, owner question 2026-11-04
entries.cause: Review rate was compared across different review rules. The old rules send every OCR document to review, so holding the rules still shows the fall on scans and photos came from changing them, while the fall on Word and PDF came from better extraction
entries.measured: Held still, the old review rules would send 56 of 129 documents on the 43 people, against 26 now. Word and PDF fell because extraction improved. Scans fell from all to 26 of 43 only because the rules changed, and 4 wrong core values on scans now go unflagged. Open: review on scans has to earn its fall with the failed-run criterion U8

entries.summary: What the failed unread run lf-unseen-4 found
entries.source: longform-b1 remainder 4, candidate-4: failed U2, U4, U6, U8
entries.cause: Form words beside a name made rival names, so the name was left blank; a name on the address's row was missed; a rule written for form labels stripped Senior from titles; addresses that lost their start were accepted; a misread domain had no check; OCR splitting or reordering a name its own address shows whole
entries.measured: Same group, now development: PDF name 35 to 43 of 43, PDF title 41 to 43, scan title 38 to 42, wrong core values not sent for review 7 to 2
